title: Indesign, Word and PDF Accessible Document Remediation to WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA
description:
Statement of Work (SOW):

Accessible Document Remediation. MS Word, PowerPoint and Adobe InDesign to WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA. (MUST HAVE)



We are seeking an experienced document accessibility remediation specialist or small team to support a confidential client project involving remediation of multiple business and policy documents to meet PDF/UA and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance standards.



The engagement involves reviewing and remediating a collection of existing Microsoft Word and PDF documents to ensure they are accessible for screen reader users and compliant with current digital accessibility standards. Deliverables will include fully accessible tagged PDFs and updated accessible source files/templates where required.



Scope of Work



The project includes:



* Remediation of several medium to high complexity reports and submissions (4) ranging from approximately 7 to 105 pages

* Structural accessibility remediation in Microsoft Word

* PDF tagging and compliance remediation to PDF/UA standards

* Reading order, heading structure, lists, tables, hyperlinks and semantic tagging

* Accessible colour contrast and formatting adjustments where required

* Alt text implementation for supplied imagery and graphics

* Accessibility uplift of an existing brand style guide

* Remediation and redesign of accessible document templates in Microsoft Word

* Quality assurance and validation against WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA requirements



Deliverables



* Final accessible PDFs compliant with PDF/UA and WCAG 2.2 AA

* Updated accessible Microsoft Word source documents/templates

* Documentation of any remediation considerations or limitations identified during the process



Project Requirements



* Strong demonstrated experience in document accessibility remediation

* Experience using tools such as Adobe Acrobat Pro, PAC, CommonLook, axesPDF, Microsoft Word accessibility tools, or equivalent

* Understanding of WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA compliance requirements

* Ability to work carefully with structured corporate and government-style documents

* High attention to detail and strong QA practices



Confidentiality



This project is being delivered under a strict confidential client engagement. Successful applicants will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) prior to receiving source materials or client information. Public disclosure of the client, project content, or deliverables will not be permitted.



Timeline



Estimated project duration is approximately 15 to 20 business days from receipt of all required source files and supporting assets.



Notes



* Supporting content such as approved alt text, optimised graphics, and final source materials will be supplied prior to commencement

* Minor layout or colour adjustments may be required to achieve accessibility compliance

* Website implementation, publishing system integration, or e-signature platform remediation are not included in scope unless separately agreed



Please include:



* Relevant accessibility remediation experience

* Examples of similar PDF/Word remediation projects

* Preferred tools and workflows

* Estimated availability during the next 4 to 6 weeks

title: Senior Medical Biller / Full-Cycle RCM Specialist - eClinicalWorks Required - Pain Management Experience Preferred

SCHEDULE:

This is not a general virtual assistant role.

We need someone who already understands U.S. provider-side outpatient billing, eClinicalWorks, denial management, A/R, payment posting, payer follow-up, appeals, and claim resolution.

- 5 to 7 years of verifiable U.S. medical billing experience

- Claim notes and documentation

- Payment posting

PAIN MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE IS A MAJOR ADVANTAGE:

Our clinic performs interventional pain procedures. Experience with pain management billing is strongly preferred.



Examples include:

- Medial branch blocks

- Radiofrequency ablation

- Epidural steroid injections

- SI joint injections

- Trigger point injections

- Joint injections

- Fluoroscopic procedures

EXCLUSIVITY AND TIME TRACKING:

This is a serious position for a serious senior RCM professional.



DAILY OUTPUT EXPECTATIONS:

At the end of each workday, you must send a brief daily report showing what you completed.



Your daily report should include items such as:

- Claims submitted

- Claims corrected

- Clearinghouse rejections worked

- Denials worked

- Appeals or reconsiderations submitted

- Payments posted

- EOBs/ERAs reviewed

- A/R accounts worked

- Payer calls or portal follow-ups completed

- Authorizations checked or followed up

- Issues requiring physician or administrator review

- Bottlenecks preventing claim resolution



DO NOT APPLY IF:

- You have less than 5 years of U.S. medical billing experience

- You do not have hands-on eClinicalWorks experience

- You only know verification of benefits

- You only know data entry

- You only know basic claim submission

- You cannot work denials independently

- You cannot explain A/R follow-up

- You are not comfortable with Time Doctor and screenshots

- You are currently working another full-time job during U.S. Central Time hours

- You are looking for flexible/asynchronous work

- You are an agency or want to subcontract the work

- You are not comfortable being measured by real output



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

A successful candidate will be able to:

- Take ownership of the billing queue

- Identify why claims are unpaid

- Correct rejected claims quickly

- Work denied claims aggressively

- Appeal medical necessity denials

- Post payments accurately

- Avoid incorrect write-offs

- Track payer follow-up

- Escalate real problems clearly

- Improve the clinic’s revenue cycle process

- Communicate clearly with the Practice Administrator and physician



HOW TO APPLY:

Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions exactly.



The very first line of your application message must be:

eClinicalWorks Senior

If this exact phrase is not the first line of your message, your application will be deleted without review.



In your application, answer the following questions:



1. How many years of U.S. provider-side medical billing experience do you have? Please list the specialties you have billed for.



2. Describe your hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks. Do not just say “I know eCW.” Explain exactly what billing tasks you performed inside eCW.



3. Describe your exact process for working a claim denied for medical necessity in eClinicalWorks. Include how you review the denial, documentation, coding, appeal/reconsideration, and follow-up.



4. Explain your experience with payment posting. How do you post an ERA/EOB, identify contractual adjustments, avoid duplicate posting, and d
 whether a balance should remain with insurance or move to the patient?



5. Explain your experience with Workers’ Compensation billing or appeals. Include examples of claim follow-up, EOR/EOB review, adjuster communication, reconsiderations, or underpayment disputes.



6. Describe your experience with pain management, interventional procedures, CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, and prior authorization requirements.



7. Confirm your availability to work full-time during U.S. Central Time business hours. Also confirm that you will not work for any other client, employer, or agency during our scheduled paid hours.



8. Confirm that you are comfortable using Time Doctor, screenshots, activity tracking, daily reports, and screen sharing.



9. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



10. Why are you the right senior RCM specialist for a pain management clinic that needs someone who can work independently?



SELECTION PROCESS:

Qualified applicants may be asked to complete the following:



- Written screening review

- Live video interview

- Technical eClinicalWorks billing interview

- Screen-share workflow discussion

- Paid practical billing test

- Reference verification

- Trial period before full access is granted



We are looking for a long-term senior RCM specialist who can take ownership of the billing process, not someone who needs to be trained from the ground up.

title: Financial Accountant - AU Company
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.



We’re looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to join our high-performing remote team. If you're a proactive finance professional who thrives on ownership, continuous improvement, and meaningful work, we’d love to meet you.



What You’ll Be Doing

As our Financial Accountant, you’ll be a key player in ensuring accurate, insightful, and timely financial reporting. You’ll collaborate across teams, drive process improvement, and uphold the financial integrity of our mission.



Key Responsibilities:

-Own the Month-End Close

Lead all aspects of EOM: journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and financial statement prep.

-Deliver Insightful Reporting

Produce monthly and quarterly management reports, including variance and trend analysis.

-Ensure Regulatory Compliance

Prepare BAS, IAS, and statutory filings, ensuring alignment with AASB and tax standards.

-Champion Continuous Improvement

Streamline workflows, introduce automation, and enhance internal controls.

-Collaborate Cross-Functionally

Partner with Marketing, Operations, and other non-finance teams to align on budget and strategy.

-Support Strategic Projects

Get involved in cost analysis, ERP upgrades, and special projects that shape our financial future.



Why Join Bare?

Make a Meaningful Impact: Your work directly supports families during one of the most vulnerable times of their lives.

Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Australia with the tools and autonomy to succeed.

Mission-Driven Culture: Join a team that leads with empathy and integrity—where your voice matters.

Growth & Innovation: Help shape scalable systems in a business that's growing fast and disrupting the norm.



About You

You’re not just technically sharp, you bring heart and high standards to everything you do. You thrive in fast-paced environments and care about doing work that matters.



Must-Haves:

-Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or similar.

-CPA/CA qualification (or in-progress).

-2–3+ years' experience in financial accounting, ideally in service-led sectors.

-Familiarity with Australian accounting standards, BAS/IAS, and financial reporting.

-Understanding of various accounting standards relevant to Bare and consolidations of many entities.

-Attention to detail and excellent reconciliation skills

-Strong ERP (MYOB, Xero, SAP) and Excel skills.

-Strong Excel/Sheets skills and automation of manual processes in your mindset-DNA



Nice-to-Haves:

• Experience in mission-driven sectors (healthcare, aged care, funeral services).

• Adaptability in high-growth or high-volume environments.

• Resilient, working with little or no supervision.

• Experience of managing international teams, interaction with multi-entity organizations, and experience within companies with a minimum annual revenue of $50 million.

• Handle ambiguity, competing priorities, and strict deadlines. Create and implement scalable processes, including training. Integrate AI and automation.



Core Values We Look For

• Empathy: You care deeply about people—colleagues and customers alike.

• Accountability: You take ownership and deliver results with pride.

• Clarity: You communicate financial information in a clear, human way.

• Curiosity: You’re always looking for a better way and love solving problems.



Perks & Benefits

-Fully remote work setup with flexible hours

-Purpose-driven work with real human impact

-Growth and learning opportunities in a scale-up environment

-Supportive, inclusive team culture



Please include your resume when submitting your application. Thank you!

title: Bookkeeper / Accounts Specialist — Xero, Trusts, Bucket Company, Div 7A & Complex Entity Structure
description:
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

IMPORTANT NOTICE:



Please read this role description carefully and make sure you fully understand what is expected before applying.



Only apply if you genuinely have all the required skills and experience listed in this role description.



If you apply and are hired based on claims that later prove inaccurate or misleading, we may end the engagement. We may leave an honest review that reflects our experience. We may also dispute any logged hours for work that does not meet the required standard.



Please do not misrepresent your experience or apply if you are not confident you can perform this role independently.



Thank you!

___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeper/Accounts Specialist with strong accounting knowledge and proven experience with Xero.



This role suits someone who has worked with trust structures, trustee companies, bucket companies, and investment activity. You should also know inter-entity accounts, related-party transactions, UPEs, and Div 7A considerations.



This is not a basic data-entry bookkeeping role. We need someone who can join our current structure and understand it fast. They will review the current account setup, find issues, and apply sound bookkeeping and accounting judgement from day one.



About the Structure



The role involves bookkeeping across a structure that includes:



Peter 

|

|-- may receive:

|   |-- trust distributions

|   |-- salary / director fees

|   |-- reimbursements

|   |-- documented loans

|   |-- potential Div 7A loans, where applicable

|

|-- Stratego Marketing Pty Ltd

|   |

|   |-- as trustee for Stratego Business Trust

|       |

|       |-- receives business income

|       |-- pays business expenses

|       |-- may distribute income/capital to beneficiaries

|       |-- may reimburse expenses

|       |-- may make documented loans or investments

|

|-- Family Trust

    |

    |-- trustee: Stratego Holdings Pty Ltd

        |

        |-- may receive investment income

        |-- may receive dividends from third-party companies

        |-- may conduct trading activity

        |-- may use margin lending

        |-- may distribute income/capital to beneficiaries

        |-- may make investments

        |

        |-- owns: Stratego Investments Pty Ltd

            |

            |-- bucket company / corporate beneficiary

            |-- may receive trust distributions

            |-- may have UPEs recorded

            |-- may retain and invest after-tax profits

            |-- may receive investment funding / loans / capital

            |-- may pay dividends to shareholder

            |-- may repay loans or pay service fees



The successful person must be comfortable working with trust accounts and trustee companies. They must understand bucket companies and related-party loans. They must also understand UPEs and Div 7A issues. They must be familiar with margin loan accounts and share trading. They must also understand dividends and investment flows.



About the Role



You will manage, review, and improve our bookkeeping and accounting records across our business and investment structure.



This role requires a strong understanding of:



- Xero accounting systems

- Trust bookkeeping

- Trustee company accounts

- Bucket company / corporate beneficiary accounts

- Chart of Accounts setup and maintenance

- Inter-entity and related-party transactions

- UPE tracking

- Div 7A loan account awareness

- Distributions, dividends, loans, reimbursements, expenses, liabilities, assets, and transfers

- Share trading and investment activity

- Margin loan account coding and reconciliation

- Bank reconciliations

- GST/BAS preparation support

- Management reporting

- Error identification and account clean-up



We need someone to review the Chart of Accounts. They must understand what each account is for. They should find anything wrong, missing, duplicated, or set up poorly. They should also flag any accounts that are not suitable.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage bookkeeping and reconciliations in Xero

- Review and maintain the Chart of Accounts

- Review coding across multiple entities and trusts

- Identify incorrect account coding and structural issues

- Clean up historical bookkeeping where required

- Reconcile bank accounts, loan accounts, trading accounts, and inter-entity accounts

- Correctly record trust distributions, UPEs, dividends, reimbursements, loans, and repayments

- Assist with Div 7A loan tracking and accountant-ready records

- Record and reconcile investment income, trading activity, dividends, franking credits, brokerage, interest, and margin loan activity

- Ensure transactions are allocated correctly across the business and investment structure

- Assist with month-end reporting and account reviews

- Work closely with management and external accountants where required

- Provide recommendations to improve accounting accuracy and reporting clarity

- Ensure records are accurate, organised, and ready for BAS, tax, accountant review, and management reporting



Required Experience



The successful applicant must have:



- Strong experience using Xero

- Solid bookkeeping and accounting knowledge

- Experience working with trusts, companies, and complex business structures

- Experience with bucket companies / corporate beneficiaries

- Understanding of UPEs and Div 7A loan accounts

- Experience with inter-company, inter-entity, and related-party transactions

- Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts design and usage

- Ability to identify problems in an existing accounting setup

- Experience reconciling loan accounts, director/shareholder accounts, and related-party accounts

- Experience preparing accounts for BAS, tax, accountants, or management reporting

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to work independently without hand-holding

- Confidence to question incorrect setups or coding

- Ability to explain accounting issues clearly and practically



Highly Regarded Experience



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:



- Trust distribution minutes and year-end distribution records

- Private company beneficiary accounts

- UPE schedules

- Division 7A loan agreements or repayment schedules

- Investment portfolio bookkeeping

- Share trading accounts

- Margin lending accounts

- Dividend and franking credit records

- Multi-entity Xero file management

- Accountant handover packs

- Historical file clean-up and account restructuring



Ideal Candidate



- You are not just someone who enters transactions. 

- You understand the accounting behind the numbers.

- You should be able to review a business structure. 

- You should assess the Chart of Accounts. 

- You should understand how the accounts are used. 

- You should be able to make the call if the setup makes sense.



You should be confident enough to say:



“This account should not be coded this way.”

“This should be a loan account, not an expense.”

“This looks like an inter-entity transfer.”

“This needs accountant review for Div 7A or UPE treatment.”

“This Chart of Accounts needs cleaning up.”



We are looking for someone who has worked across many businesses and can quickly spot when something is wrong. We do not want someone who simply follows instructions. The right person must understand the structure and apply accounting judgement.



Important Requirement

- Monitor comments, messages, and interactions; respond or escalate as needed

- Track content performance and recommend data-driven improvements

- Maintain consistent branding, tone, and messaging across all platforms

- Support ongoing marketing campaigns and growth initiatives

- Assist with basic administrative tasks such as file organization, scheduling, and coordination

- Collaborate closely with the team to ensure efficient execution of marketing strategies







Outcomes We Expect



We expect you to help us achieve the following:

- Improved overall social engagement 

- More consistent and professional content output and brand presence

- Clear improvement in content performance based on insights and adjustments

- Stronger alignment between content and target audience behavior

- Increased audience interaction and message responsiveness

- Organized and efficient content planning and scheduling system

- Contribution to basic administrative tasks.





Ideal Candidate



- Strong experience in social media management and content creation

- With understanding of engagement strategies and audience behavior

- Ability to balance creative work with analytical thinking

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently

- Good communication skills and responsiveness







Position Details



- Part-time, remote work

- Flexible schedule (must meet deadlines)

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate

- Platforms you are strongest in 
, Instagram, TikTok, etc.)

title: AI Video Specialist
description:
Background

We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more.



We’re looking for a full-time AI Video Specialist to create AI-generated clips and turn them into polished, high-retention videos using our internal workflows.



This is an execution-focused role, not strategy.



You’ll be working from clear briefs, proven systems, and step-by-step SOPs for every task.



If you haven’t used every tool in our stack yet, that’s completely fine. We’ll train the right person.



What You’ll Do

- Video Editing

- Turn raw footage into engaging short-form content (Reels, Shorts)

- Add captions, overlays, transitions, sound design, and B-roll using CapCut

- Follow brand guidelines and client briefs with precision

- Incorporate feedback quickly and accurately

- Deliver consistent daily output, on time

- Maintain consistency across multiple client accounts



AI Clip Generation

- Create AI video assets using tools like Veo3 and HeyGen

- Execute SOPs exactly (prompts, settings, and formats are predefined)

- Review all outputs for quality (accuracy, artifacts, exports) before submission

- Flag issues and suggest improvements to workflows

- Keep all assets organized and clearly labeled for handoff



General

- Manage multiple client projects without missing deadlines

- Maintain clean, structured file systems

- Communicate proactively about progress, timelines, and blockers



Requirements

- Must-Haves

- Proven experience editing short-form content (portfolio required)

- Strong English communication skills (written and spoken)

- Solid proficiency in CapCut

- Start your application with the word “hook” so we know you’ve read the full job description

- Comfortable following structured SOPs (execute first, refine second)

- High attention to detail and quality

- Ability to manage multiple projects at once

- Reliable internet and a dedicated workspace

- Minimum 2 hours of timezone overlap with the team (based in the US & Canada)

- Coachable, adaptable, and quick to learn new tools



Nice-to-Haves

- Experience with AI video tools (Veo3, HeyGen, etc.)

- Background in an agency or content production environment

- Understanding of short-form performance (hooks, pacing, retention)

- Familiarity with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar tools

- Access to a VPN with a dedicated IP



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Clear systems and SOPs — no guesswork

- Training on AI tools for the right candidate

- Direct communication and fast feedback

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses (up to 50% of monthly pay, dependent on performance)

- Access to all required tools



How to Apply:



Include all of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed:

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2–3 talking head edits

- AI-generated video samples (if available)

- Short answer (3–5 sentences): What do you do when an SOP is unclear?

- Your timezone + working hours



No portfolio = no review.

title: Bookkeeping Accountant (E-commerce / Beauty Brand)
description:
About the Company



We are a fast-growing beauty brand headquartered in Singapore, with presence in Singapore, Malaysia and Hong Kong, selling via e-commerce and retail (e.g. Watsons). We are a lean, ambitious team and we’re looking for a long-term bookkeeping accountant to help us keep our finances clean, organized and ready for growth.



This is a remote, full-time role for someone who wants stability, clear responsibilities and room to grow with the business.



About the Role



You will own the day-to-day bookkeeping for the group (mainly Singapore & Malaysia entities), keep our records accurate and up to date, and support the founder with monthly reports, cashflow visibility and basic analysis.



You must be very detail-oriented, organized and reliable, with strong experience in bookkeeping for SMEs or e-commerce businesses.



Key Responsibilities



1. Daily / Weekly Bookkeeping

Bank accounts



Payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, PayNow, etc.)



E-commerce platforms (Shopify / website, TikTok Shop, Shopee/Lazada if applicable)



Enter and reconcile supplier invoices and payments.



2. Bank & Account Reconciliation

Payment gateways



E-commerce payouts



Marketplace statements (e.g. Watsons, online platforms)



Investigate and resolve discrepancies promptly.



3. Accounts Payable & Receivable

Prepare simple payment schedules and reminders as needed.



4. Monthly Closing & Reports



Prepare monthly P&L and Balance Sheet (per entity and consolidated).

Nice-to-Have (Bonus)



Experience working with e-commerce / online businesses (Shopify, WooCommerce, marketplaces, etc.).

title: Full-Time DaVinci Resolve Editor — Personal Brand + Tech Content (Clean Cinematic Style)
description:
Hi! I'm Hudson — I run a small agency and a few content brands out of

Australia. I'm hiring ONE full-time video editor to be my right hand for

all of my video content for the next 12+ months. This is a long-term

role with room to grow, not a project gig.



You will be editing:

 — Long-form YouTube videos (10–25 min) about building software,

   business, and tech

 — Short-form vertical content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and

   YouTube Shorts (15–60 sec)

 — Product launch videos and demo reels for two software brands

 — Occasional case studies and client-facing videos



Volume estimate: roughly 1 long-form + 4–6 shorts per week.



THE LOOK I'M GOING FOR



Look up Daniel Dalen on YouTube. Watch any 3 of his videos. That's

the aesthetic — clean, cinematic, restrained, lots of breathing room,

warm film-style colour grade, big simple typography, deliberate

silence and pacing, motion that feels intentional instead of busy.



On top of that visual language, the shorts need a dry, deadpan,


-aware sense of humour. Think: a perfectly composed cinematic

shot, then a hard cut to a stupid stock clip with a text overlay.

Self-aware, internet-native, never cringey. If you've watched Theo

Vier, Pirate Software, or Casey Neistat's recent stuff, you know

the energy.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



 — DaVinci Resolve (Studio or free, I will provide Studio license)

 — A portfolio with at least 3 pieces in a clean cinematic style

   — colour-graded, not raw out of camera

 — Comfortable cutting both long-form (with story structure) and

   short-form (with hook + retention pacing)

 — Working English — you do not need to be a native speaker, but

   I need to brief you in writing and have you understand without

   3 follow-ups

 — Stable internet (at least 25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up) for

   transferring files via 
 and Google Drive

 — A computer that can handle 4K Resolve timelines without crashing

 — Available roughly 40 hours per week. Hours are flexible — pick

   the schedule that suits you, just hit deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



 — Motion graphics chops (Fusion inside Resolve, or After Effects)

 — Sound design / basic audio cleanup

 — Thumbnail design or willingness to learn

 — Experience editing for solo creators or personal brands

 — A genuine sense of humour — I would rather hire a funny editor

   who can learn to be cinematic than a cinematic editor who has

   no taste for jokes



WHAT YOU WILL NOT BE DOING



 — Filming. I shoot everything myself.

 — Writing scripts. I write all the long-forms.

 — Posting / scheduling. A social media person handles that.

 — Editing for my Black Hat brand — that has a separate workflow.



COMPENSATION + STRUCTURE



 — Full-time role: 40 hours per week

 — Salary: ?40,000–?55,000 PHP per month (? $700–$950 USD) depending

   on experience. I pay above-market on purpose because I want

   someone who plans to stay 2+ years, not someone shopping for

   their next gig in 6 months.

 — Paid every 2 weeks via Wise (no PayPal fees, you get the full

   amount)

 — 13th month pay included

 — 30-day probation period, then ongoing

 — 10 days paid leave + Philippine public holidays

 — DaVinci Studio license, 
 seat, and any plugins I ask you

   to use are provided

 — Annual raise review based on output, not tenure



HIRING PROCESS



 1. Reply to this post with the questions below answered (1–2 days)

 2. If shortlisted, I'll send a PAID trial edit. $25 USD flat fee

    via Wise on delivery, whether you get the job or not. Real

    footage, real brief, ~3 hours of your time. (~2 days)

 3. If your trial is strong, 30-min Zoom interview (1 day)

 4. Offer + start within a week



I will move fast. If I don't reply within 4 days, assume I've

shortlisted other applicants — apply to other jobs, don't wait on me.



TO APPLY



Reply with:



 1. Start your message with the exact phrase: "I just want to ship

    weird stuff" — this is how I filter out copy-paste applicants

 2. Links to 3 portfolio pieces (YouTube/Vimeo/Drive), short note

    on what you edited

 3. Which Daniel Dalen video is your favourite and why (1–3

    sentences, doesn't need to be deep — I just want to confirm

    you watched)

 4. Your current monthly rate expectation in PHP

 5. Your weekly capacity (hours/week) if I hired you today

 6. Your internet speed (run 
, screenshot if you can)

 7. Your computer specs (CPU, RAM, GPU)

 8. One sentence: what's the most recent piece of internet content

    that made you laugh out loud?



Applications that don't include the opening phrase or skip

questions will be rejected without reply. Sorry — I get 200+

applicants and this is the only way to keep my sanity.



Thanks for reading this far. Looking forward to seeing your work.



— Hudson

I run a fast-growing credit enhancement and business funding company. We generate inbound leads daily through Instagram content, reels, stories, funnels, and outbound outreach.



This role is NOT just customer service.



Conversations = revenue.



Your job is to help organize, manage, follow up with, and nurture leads while keeping 
ntum alive and moving people toward a decision.



We prioritize closing through DMs whenever possible, while escalating higher-level or more complex conversations when needed.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:



• Managing inbound leads (Instagram,
, SMS, CRM)

• Supporting sales efforts during viral content pushes and campaigns

• Helping keep the inbox organized during high lead volume periods

• Maintaining fast response times and strong communication flow



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF:



• You have experience in DM sales, lead nurturing, or conversational sales

• You know how to guide conversations naturally toward a sale

• You understand how to build trust quickly

• You are organized and good at keeping track of conversations

• You can handle high DM volume without getting overwhelmed

• You understand Instagram/social media culture and communication

• You can adapt your tone naturally (NOT robotic or scripted)

• You know how to follow up without sounding desperate or pushy

• You think ahead and don’t wait to be told every little thing

• You understand that consistency in follow-up creates revenue



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You only know how to copy/paste scripts

• You disappear or respond slowly

• You get overwhelmed easily by conversations

• You are uncomfortable talking about money or sales

• You only know how to book calls and not nurture conversations

• You pass leads off immediately instead of warming them up

• You cannot adapt your communication style naturally

• You’ve never worked in a sales-focused or lead management role



BONUS IF YOU HAVE:



• Experience in credit repair, funding, or financial services

• Experience using GoHighLevel or CRM systems

• Experience managing inbound Instagram leads

• Strong understanding of sales psychology

• Experience handling objections in DMs

• Experience with lead tracking and pipeline organization

• Experience with voice notes and conversational selling



HOURS:



Part-time (approx. 20 hours/week to start)

Flexible schedule based around lead activity and response times



Starting pay:

$5/hour + performance-based incentives tied to conversions and sales support.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS (READ CAREFULLY):



At the VERY TOP of your application, write:

“I UNDERSTAND THAT FOLLOW-UP CREATES SALES.”



Then include:



• Your resume

• Screenshots/examples of DM conversations where you helped nurture or close a lead (REQUIRED)

• Your experience with DM sales, lead management, or follow-up systems

• Your experience using Google Sheets, CRMs, or lead tracking systems



Then answer this:



A lead says:

“I’m interested, but I need to think about it.”



What would you say next?



FINAL NOTE:



This role is for someone who understands:



• Attention means nothing without follow-up

• Most sales happen in the follow-up

• Conversations are opportunities

• Your job is to move people from interested ? committed



If you know how to do that, you’ll do very well here.



If not, this is not the role for you.

title: Seeking a Senior HVAC Controls & Energy Project Developer / BAS Scope Developer.
description:
This is not a traditional mechanical design role and does not require the candidate to be the PE of record. We need someone with strong HVAC controls, BAS/DDC, commissioning, retro-commissioning, or energy project development experience who can help turn building conditions into clear, executable scopes.



The ideal candidate can walk a commercial, healthcare, or institutional facility and develop HVAC/BAS energy conservation measures, including existing conditions summaries, controls deficiencies, rough point lists, sequence of operations intent, BAS integration assumptions, VFD/AHU/VAV/boiler/chiller/pump scope, trend log requests, savings logic, contractor scope of work, proposal narratives, budget assumptions, risks, exclusions, and customer dependencies.



We already have controls contractors who can perform programming and implementation. What we need is someone who can identify what is wrong with the building, define how to fix it, explain what the controls contractor needs to do, and help communicate the value and savings to the customer and utility program.



Relevant backgrounds may include BAS Project Engineer, HVAC Controls Engineer, DDC Controls Project Engineer, Controls Applications Engineer, Retro-Commissioning Engineer, Commissioning/RCx Project Manager, Building Automation Engineer, or HVAC Energy Engineer.



California Mechanical PE experience is a plus, but not required. We may use a separate PE for review/stamping when needed.

title: Virtual Assistant — Cold Call Appointment Setter (Part-Time, $3/hr)
description:
# Virtual Assistant — Cold Call Appointment Setter (Part-Time, $3/hr)



**Company:** TaskBlink

**Role:** Appointment Setter / Cold Caller

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM EST (US Eastern Time)

**Hours:** 20 hours per week (4 hours/day)

**Pay:** $3.00 USD per hour

**Location:** Remote (Work from Home)



---



## ? The #1 Thing We Care About: Your Spoken English



This role is **100% phone-based cold calling to US prospects**. Your English speaking ability is the single biggest factor in whether you'll succeed here — and whether we'll hire you.



We are looking for:



- **Clear, neutral, easy-to-understand English** that an American prospect can follow without strain

- **Confidence and warmth in your voice** — you sound like a real person, not a script reader

- **Strong pronunciation and pacing** — no rushing, no mumbling, no heavy accent that forces the prospect to ask "what?"

- **The ability to think on your feet in English** when prospects throw objections or unexpected questions



If your spoken English is not strong, please do not apply — you will not pass the voice screening stage. If your English **is** strong, this is your job to win.



---



## ????? Voice Recording Is Mandatory



**Applications without a voice recording will be deleted unread.** This is the only way we evaluate the most important skill for this role.



**What to record (60–90 seconds):**



1. Introduce yourself — your name, where you're based, your time zone

2. Walk us through your cold calling experience (industries, dialers, daily dial counts, appointments set per week)

3. Pretend you just called a stranger in the US for TaskBlink and they picked up — deliver your best 20-second cold opener

4. Tell us why you'd be great on our team



**How to submit your recording:**



- Record on your phone or computer, in the same quiet environment you'd be working in

- Upload to Google Drive, Vocaroo, or Loom and paste the link in your application

- Make sure the link is **set to public** or "anyone with the link can view" — if we can't open it, we can't review you



**Tips to stand out:** Smile while you record (it changes your voice), speak at a natural pace, and don't read from a script word-for-word — we want to hear the real you on a real call.



---



## About TaskBlink



TaskBlink is a growing service business expanding our outbound appointment-setting team. We provide full training, proven scripts, pre-loaded lead lists, and the dialing tools you need to succeed. Our top setters book consistent appointments and have a long-term home with us.



---



## What You'll Do



- Make a minimum of **60 dials per hour** (240 dials per shift)

- Follow our proven cold call script and objection handling framework

- Book qualified appointments directly into our calendar

- Log every call accurately in our CRM (notes, outcome, next steps)

- Send a short end-of-shift summary (dials, contacts, appointments)

- Show up on time, every shift, ready to dial



---



## Other Requirements



These are important — but they all come second to your spoken English.



**Required:**

- Reliable computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old)

- Stable internet of at least 25 Mbps (we will test this)

- USB headset with noise-cancelling microphone (no AirPods or laptop mics)

- Quiet workspace — no background noise during shifts

- Ability to work Noon–4 PM EST every weekday without exception (convert to your local time before applying)



**Preferred:**

- 6+ months of previous cold calling or appointment setting experience

- Experience with dialers (Mojo, CallTools, ReadyMode, Five9, or similar)

- Experience with CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, or similar)

- Track record of hitting daily dial and appointment quotas



---



## What We Provide



- Full script and objection handling training

- Pre-loaded lead lists (you don't source your own)

- Dialer software and CRM access

- Weekly coaching and call reviews

- Performance bonuses for appointments set above target

- Long-term position for the right person



---



## Pay Structure



- **Base:** $3.00 USD/hour, paid weekly via Wise, PayPal, or your preferred method

- **Bonus:** Additional bonus per qualified appointment that shows up

- Time tracked via Hubstaff or similar



---



## How to Apply



Reply with **all** of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. ? **Your voice recording link** (60–90 seconds, see instructions above) — **most important**

2. ? Brief written summary of your cold calling experience

3. ? Speed test screenshot from fast.com or speedtest.net

4. ? Your time zone + confirmation you can work Noon–4 PM EST every weekday

5. ? The word **"DIAL"** at the top of your application so we know you read the full posting



---



## What Happens Next



We screen voice recordings first. Strong speakers move to a short video interview, then a paid trial shift. Top performers earn a permanent position within their first two weeks.



We're hiring this week. If your English is strong and you can dial with confidence — apply now.

Part-Time to Start | Long-Term Opportunity



We are an Australian footwear and apparel business looking for a highly experienced, detail-focused Ecommerce, Shopify & Creative Marketing Assistant to support our Shopify website, product data, retail promotions, social media content, graphics, and ecommerce operations.



This is a long-term role for the right person. We would like to start part-time and increase hours once the person understands our business, systems, and standards.



This role is best suited to someone who has already worked in ecommerce, Shopify, product data, creative marketing, and social media — not someone who needs to learn everything from the beginning.



About the Role



The right person must be accurate, organised, proactive, and able to work independently after receiving instructions. Attention to detail is extremely important. You will be working across Shopify, product updates, inventory-related tasks, reporting, promotional artwork, website banners, social media content, and campaign execution.



Key Responsibilities

Update Shopify products, descriptions, images, tags, collections, and basic product information

Assist with Shopify inventory and product data updates

Check website content for accuracy, spelling, pricing, images, and consistency

Work with Excel, Google Sheets, CSV files, SKUs, sales, and inventory data

Clean, organise, and compare product or sales information

Prepare basic reports and identify best sellers, slow movers, and sales trends

Create simple promotional banners and graphics for Shopify, retail, and social media

Resize artwork for website banners, Instagram posts, stories, and digital screens

Assist with social media planning, captions, scheduling, and campaign execution

Help maintain a simple promotional/content calendar

Skills Required

Shopify experience preferred

Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

Basic graphic design ability using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar

Social media planning or posting experience

Strong attention to detail

Good written English

Ability to follow written instructions and SOPs

Ability to work independently after training

Willingness to learn and grow with the role Very Important



Accuracy is critical.



We are not looking for someone who rushes through tasks. We need someone who reads instructions properly, checks their own work before submitting it, and asks questions when something is unclear.



Nice to Have



Experience with any of the following would be helpful:



Shopify product CSV uploads

Shopify reports

Inventory management

Retail promotions

Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar
 platforms

Marketplace platforms

Social media scheduling tools

Basic video editing or reels

Footwear, apparel, retail, or ecommerce experience

How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Details of your relevant experience, including how long you have worked in each area, especially:

Shopify

Excel 

Graphic design / Canva / Photoshop

Social media planning or posting

Ecommerce, retail, inventory, or product data

Examples of banners, social media posts, or creative work you have made

Your hourly rate in AUD

Your availability and preferred working hours

The word “ORANGE” at the top of your application so we know you have read the full job post carefully

title: Contract Video Editor
description:
We are a fast-growing consumer brand with a focus on performance socks built on thoughtful design, quality products, and strong operational execution. As we continue to scale across ecommerce, wholesale, and new channels, operational excellence is critical to delivering a great experience for our customers and partners. We're a lean, collaborative team where ownership matters, communication is direct, and everyone plays a role in building systems that scale.



About the Role

We're looking for a contracted Video Editor to join our content team. This role is entirely focused on one thing: taking footage we've shot and editing it into high-converting, scroll-stopping video ads for Meta.



We'll provide the footage, briefs, and creative direction. What we need from you is the craft, taste, and execution to turn raw material into ads worth testing. This is a full-time hours contract position open to candidates anywhere in the world.



Key Responsibilities

Post-Production & Editing

• Edit 10+ Meta ad variations per week from provided footage, testing different hooks, CTAs, music, pacing, and formats

• Take LOG footage through a full post-production pipeline to a polished REC709 deliverable

• Apply color grading, sound design, captions, overlays, and transitions to produce clean, on-brand outputs

• Execute creative briefs provided by the team while adhering to brand guidelines in every cut



Organization & Administration

• Download, manage, and upload footage and deliverables to the team’s cloud storage with a high standard of organization

• Work within Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, and Air for day-to-day project and asset management

• Follow established team processes and systems with consistency, as a remote team we rely on workflows to keep production running smoothly



Required Skills

Technical

• High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of LOG profiles, LUTs, and color grading workflows (LOG to REC709)

• Understanding of frame rates, video formats, resolutions, and delivery specs for Meta platforms

• Audio editing: music selection and editing, basic mixing, dialogue cleanup, and sound design

• Motion graphics and animation experience is a strong asset



Creative

• A strong eye for pacing, visual storytelling, and what makes short-form content stop the scroll

• Ability to hook viewers within the first two seconds, deliver a message clearly and simply, and keep them watching

• Good creative instincts to align editing decisions with brand look, tone, and goals

• Comfortable working from briefs and producing creative output that serves a specific objective



Soft Skills

• Highly organized with a strong ability to follow processes and maintain systems independently

• Fast, self-motivated, and execution-focused

• Collaborative and open to feedback and direction

• Comfortable working with tight deadlines and constant iteration



Culture Fit

We're looking for someone passionate about fitness, self-improvement, and athletic lifestyles. You appreciate resilience, work well collaboratively, and take pride in producing high-quality work. We want someone motivated by seeing their work make an impact and contributing to a growing brand.

title: EA/Project Manager (Comic Books-Full Time)
description:
Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 3 years with us is worth 10 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your peers by being on this team. If you win here the rest of your life will be different. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!



If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding



We don’t need another task hopper. Looking for a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked



We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



Who This Is NOT For

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure



Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

Comp: Starting base $600–$700, with performance bonuses that take you to $900+ when you consistently hit + beat KPIs.”

Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs, & raising the standard, not time served

If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. No ceiling. This is what you make it.



How To Apply

Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:

Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):



Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion without delegating. What tools did you use to track it, what were the exact deliverables, and what was the measurable result?

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.



Also attach your PDF/Googledrive resume link.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

title: QA/QC Specialist for Data Annotation
description:
We are looking for a QA/QC Specialist with previous Data Annotation experience to join our team. This role will focus on reviewing annotation work, improving quality, and assisting the Manager in developing better systems, SOPs, QA workflows, and documentation.



The right candidate must be detail-oriented, organized, and experienced in checking annotation outputs for accuracy and consistency.



Responsibilities

-Review completed data annotation tasks for accuracy, completeness, and consistency

-Check labels, classifications, geometry, alignment, and geolocation accuracy

-Identify annotation errors and provide clear feedback to annotators

-Assist the Manager in improving QA systems, SOPs, workflows, checklists, and documentation

-Help monitor team quality performance and recurring errors

-Maintain QA reports, error logs, feedback records, and quality scorecards

-Support training, calibration, and quality alignment sessions

-Help ensure all annotation work follows project guidelines and quality standards

-Recommend process improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and team consistency



Tools and Software Used



The candidate should have experience with, or be willing to learn:



-CVAT for image/video annotation review

-QGIS for geospatial and mapping validation

-Mapbox for map-based review

-Viewfinder for imagery inspection

-Time tracking tools

-Internal SOPs, QA checklists, reporting sheets, and annotation guidelines



Requirements

-Previous experience in Data Annotation QA/QC or annotation review

-Experience using annotation tools such as CVAT, QGIS, Mapbox, Viewfinder, or similar platforms

-Strong attention to detail

-Ability to identify and explain annotation errors clearly

-Good understanding of QA processes, guidelines, and quality standards

-Strong written communication skills

-Organized, reliable, and able to work with minimal supervision

-Comfortable helping improve SOPs, workflows, and QA documentation



Preferred Experience

-Road-related annotation experience, such as road signs, lane markings, road striping, pavement markings, or mapping validation

-Experience working with remote annotation teams

-Experience creating or improving QA checklists, SOPs, training materials, or quality reports

-Experience tracking quality metrics and productivity



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who can do more than just check work. The ideal candidate should be able to help us improve our overall annotation process, support the team, identify recurring issues, and assist management in building a stronger QA/QC system.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



-Your updated resume or CV

-A short summary of your Data Annotation and QA/QC experience

-The annotation or GIS tools you have used before

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
About YourEra AI Agency

YourEra is a native AI agency. We run complete AI transformation projects for service-based businesses doing $4M to $40M in revenue — Claude Skills, 
 workflows, custom GPTs, autonomous agents, full automation stacks. We don't sell theory. We build.



The founder, Nick Hughes, has delivered 30+ multi-million-dollar digital transformation projects at one of the largest software companies in the world. His expertise is consulting and client relationships — he's business-first, not a deep technical operator. He knows how to scope a transformation, sell it in, manage stakeholders, and ship outcomes that move the P&L. That's why clients hire YourEra.



You'll work directly with Nick. He brings the strategy, the client, and the scoped use case. You bring the build.



About the Role

-We've just signed a 12-month contract with a new client — a property valuation firm operating across Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane with around 20 staff and a roadmap of 24 AI use cases to deploy over the next year. The work spans Claude Skills for desktop and long-form valuation reports, 
 automations between 
, Xero, SharePoint and Outlook, an internal sales-evidence database, an AI quote bot, a marketing engine spanning Google Ads, SEO, and AI-SEO (LLM citation optimisation), and more.



We need a Deployment Specialist to be Nick's right hand on the build — turning scoped use cases into shipped, tested, working automations.



You don't need to know 
 or Claude on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can learn them quickly, and then learn the next tool just as fast. We'll train you.

This is a full-time role: 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. Roughly 6 hours per day on client builds, and 2 hours per day on structured upskilling — courses, certifications, building practice projects in Claude and 
. We invest in you growing as fast as the agency does.



What you'll do



- Build Claude Skills from scoped requirements — instructions, SOPs, prompt logic, do-NOT-use clauses, test sets

- Build 
 scenarios end-to-end — webhooks, routers, error handlers, data stores — connecting 
, Xero, SharePoint, Outlook/M365, and the Claude API

- Configure Claude Connectors for clients — Gmail, Google Drive, Monday, SharePoint, Teams, and custom MCP servers where needed

- Write CLAUDE.md files, system prompts, and prompt libraries in the client's voice

- Run Google Ads work — campaign builds, keyword research, ad copy, landing page briefs, performance reporting

- Run SEO work — technical audits, on-page optimisation, content briefs, internal linking, programmatic page builds

- Run AI-SEO work — optimising client content to be cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews

- Test, QA and iterate every build before it goes to the client — log what breaks, fix it

- Document every build — a clear SOP the client's team can follow, in plain English

- Sit on client tuning calls with Nick, take notes, turn feedback into the next iteration the same week

- Maintain the build tracker across all 24 use cases — what's scoped, in build, in QA, live

- Handover and train — walk client staff through each build at go-live



What we're looking for



- Honesty and integrity, above everything else. When you say you'll do something, you do it. When you don't know something, you say so. When you miss a deadline, you tell us before we have to ask. This is non-negotiable — every other skill on this list is teachable, this one isn't.



- A fast learner — you don't need 
, Claude, Google Ads, or SEO experience on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can pick up a new tool over a weekend and be useful with it on Monday



- Technically curious — you like figuring out how things work, you read documentation without being asked, and you're not afraid of an API



- Logical, structured thinker — you can take a process, break it into steps, and spot where it'll break before it does

Comfortable with the common SaaS stack — 
, Xero, SharePoint/M365, Outlook, Google Workspace, Notion



- Excellent written English — most communication is async, in writing, and the client reads everything

Detail obsessed — you test before you ship, you check the output, you find the bug before the client does



- Self-managing — you can take a scoped use case and run with it. You ask the right questions and don't wait to be told what to do



- Available during AEST business hours for at least 4 hours of overlap each day (Philippines timezone is workable)

Bonus: prior exposure to no-code automation (Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable), prompt engineering, Google Ads, SEO, scripting (JavaScript, Python), or working with AI tools day-to-day



Nice to have



- A portfolio or examples of anything technical you've built or taught yourself — the project matters less than what it says about how you learn

- Front-end skills (HTML/CSS, basic React) for client-facing dashboards

- Experience writing technical documentation for non-technical users



What you'll get



- Full-time, long-term role with the agency

- 2 paid hours per day for structured upskilling — courses, certifications, practice builds

- Direct mentorship from Nick — you'll learn the consulting side, the client side, and the build side of AI transformation

- Variety — 24 use cases, multiple tools, real client work, no two weeks the same

- Salary commensurate with experience, paid in USD, plus performance bonuses on shipped builds





How to apply

- Send a short message (no cover letter please) covering:



- The most complex thing you've ever taught yourself — what it was, how long it took, and what you used to learn it

- A time you missed a commitment and how you handled it

- A link to your portfolio, GitHub, or a Loom walking through anything you've built

- Your hourly or monthly rate expectation in USD

- When you can start

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Meta & TikTok Ads (Direct Response Focus)
description:
About Us



Maven Media is a US-based Meta and TikTok ads agency focused on lead generation for clients in competitive, compliance-heavy verticals (financial services, lending, legal, professional services). We don’t make pretty brand videos. We make ads that get the click, the lead, and the conversion. If you’ve only edited wedding reels or YouTube vlogs, this role is not for you.



The Role



You will edit short-form video ads (9:16, primarily 15 to 45 seconds) for our agency clients running on Meta and TikTok. You will work directly with the agency principal (me). I write the scripts, build the shot lists, and give you scene-by-scene direction. Your job is to execute that direction at a high standard, fast, and with strong attention to performance creative principles (hook in the first 1.5 seconds, pattern interrupts, captions, pacing, retention).



This is a long-term role. I am not looking for a freelancer to ghost me after two videos. I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the agency.



What You’ll Do:



- Edit 1x1 and 9:16 short-form ads from raw footage, AI-generated UGC clips (Heygen, Arcads, similar), stock footage, and screen recordings

- Follow scene-by-scene direction fro
 (timing, cuts, B-roll inserts, text overlays, captions, music)

- Add burned-in captions with proper sync and ad-friendly styling

- Apply on-screen text, motion graphics, zoom-ins, and visual hooks

- Source supporting B-roll and stock when briefs require it

- Deliver multiple variations of the same base ad (hook swaps, CTA swaps, format swaps for split testing)

- Output in correct specs for Meta and TikTok (9:16, 1:1 when needed, sound-on and sound-off versions)

- Hit turnaround windows (target: 24 to 48 hours per ad variant)



Must Haves:



- Proven experience editing short-form vertical ads for Meta and/or TikTok (send examples)

- Fluent in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve (CapCut Pro is a plus, it’s what we’ll likely standardize on)

- Strong grasp of direct response video principles: hook, problem, solution, social proof, CTA

- Ability to follow detailed written briefs without going off-script

- Fast caption work with accurate sync

- Reliable internet, dedicated workstation, headphones for audio QC

- Excellent written English (you’ll receive briefs in English and need to ask clear questions when something is unclear)

- Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (negotiable)



Nice-to-Haves:



- Experience editing AI UGC content (Heygen avatars, AI voiceovers)

- Basic motion graphics (After Effects or CapCut equivalent)

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager creative specs and TikTok Ads Manager

- Understanding of compliance constraints in financial services / lending advertising (no problem if not, I’ll train)

- Sound design instincts (knowing when to add a whoosh, a beat drop, etc.)



How We Work:



- Briefs delivered via Slack or ClickUp with scene-by-scene direction, reference videos, and raw assets

- Async communication first, video calls only when needed

- Weekly check-in call (30 minutes)

- Files exchanged via Google Drive or 

- Revisions are normal. Defensiveness about revisions is not.



Compensation:



- Full-time role (40 hours/week)

- Starting range: $800 to $1,200/month USD depending on experience and portfolio

- Paid via Xoom, Wise or Payoneer, twice monthly

About Us:

We are a US-based property management company operating with a deep commitment to Continuous Improvement and Lean principles, modeled after the Toyota Production System. We use specific training curriculums (including Moodle and Gemba concepts) to guide our operations. We are looking for a dedicated tea
mber to become an expert in our systems and help us improve our daily processes.

Training: Gain experience with Lean/Toyota Production Syste
thodologies—valuable skills for any future career in operations or engineering.

title: Operations & Project Manager (Comic Books-Full Time)
description:
Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 3 years with us is worth 10 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your peers by being on this team. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!



If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 



We don’t need another task hopper. Looking for a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked



We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



Who This Is NOT For

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market 

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure



Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

Comp: Starting base $600–$700, with performance bonuses that take you to $900+ when you consistently hit + beat KPIs.” 

Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs, & raising the standard, not time served

If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. No ceiling. This is what you make it. 



How To Apply

Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):



Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion without delegating. What tools did you use to track it, what were the exact deliverables, and what was the measurable result?

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.



Also attach your PDF/Googledrive resume link



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

s professionally

Requirements:

Minimum 3 years experience as a VA, admin, or customer service rep (HVAC is a plus)

Highly organized with strong multitasking ability

Comfortable using scheduling/field-service software

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

???? Voice Recording Requirement (IMPORTANT)



Before sending your resume, please submit a 1–2 minute voice recording of a mock customer call.



Instructions:

Play both the customer and the company representative

Speak clearly, naturally, and at a normal pace

Do NOT read word-for-word — we want it to sound like a real call

Record in a quiet environment (no background noise)

Scenario to Act Out:



A customer calls because their AC is not working properly on a hot day.



Include the following in your call:



Greeting and introduction

Asking for the customer’s name and contact information

Understanding the issue (ask at least 2–3 questions)

Show empathy and professionalism

Offer scheduling options

Confirm next steps clearly

Example Structure (Do NOT read this exactly):



You (Tiger Air):

“Hi, thank you for calling Tiger Air, this is [Your Name]. How can I help you today?”



Customer:

“My AC is blowing warm air and it’s really hot in the house.”



You:

“I’m sorry to hear that — I know how uncomfortable that can be, especially in this heat. Let me ask you a couple quick questions so we can get this taken care of.”



(Ask questions like:)



When did this start?

Is the unit turning on at all?

Has this issue happened before?



Then:

“I’m going to get you scheduled as soon as possible. We have availability later today between 2–4 PM or tomorrow morning between 8–10 AM. What works better for you?”



Finish with:

“Perfect, I’ve got you scheduled. You’ll receive a confirmation shortly, and our technician will give you a call when he’s on the way.”
