title: ERP administrator
description:
ERP Administrator / ERP Operations Specialist

About the Company



We are a fast-growing international B2B wholesale and distribution company working with large retail partners across Europe. Our business involves a wide product catalogue, supplier integrations, product data management, stock and price updates, order processing, logistics coordination, and operational communication with major retail platforms and partners.



We are looking for a highly capable ERP Administrator / ERP Operations Specialist who can take responsibility for the quality, accuracy, structure, and reliability of our ERP system and related operational workflows.



This is not a simple data-entry role. We are looking for someone who understands how an ERP system supports the entire business: purchasing, sales, stock management, pricing, product data, reporting, logistics, invoicing, supplier communication, and internal decision-making.



The right person must be analytical, structured, detail-oriented, and able to think independently.



Role Overview



As an ERP Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining, controlling, improving, and optimizing the company’s ERP system and operational data flows.



You will work with product data, supplier files, customer orders, stock levels, pricing logic, purchase documents, sales documents, warehouse data, and reporting tools. Your role will be to ensure that the ERP system reflects the real operational situation of the company accurately and consistently.



You will also help identify mistakes, improve processes, standardize data, support integrations, and communicate with internal teams to make sure information in the system is complete, reliable, and useful.



We need someone who does not simply “enter data,” but understands what the data means and how it affects the business.



Key Responsibilities

ERP System Administration



Manage and maintain the company’s ERP system on a daily basis.



Ensure that product, supplier, customer, order, pricing, stock, and invoice data are correctly entered, updated, and controlled.



Monitor the accuracy and consistency of ERP records across different modules.



Identify incorrect, missing, duplicated, outdated, or inconsistent data.



Create, update, and maintain product records, supplier profiles, customer profiles, price lists, stock information, and operational documents.



Support users across the company when they face ERP-related issues.



Document ERP procedures, rules, naming conventions, data standards, and internal workflows.



Product Data & Catalogue Management



Maintain structured product data, including SKU, EAN, brand, model, category, product descriptions, specifications, images, pricing, supplier references, and other product attributes.



Review supplier product files and prepare them for ERP import.



Clean, normalize, validate, and structure product data before upload.



Identify mismatches between supplier data, internal ERP data, and customer platform requirements.



Work with large Excel/CSV files and understand the relationship between product data, pricing, stock, and sales performance.



Help improve the quality of the product catalogue so that it can be used efficiently for sales, retail partner integrations, and reporting.



Stock, Pricing & Supplier Data



Update and verify supplier stock and price lists.



Compare supplier prices with internal sales prices and identify potential issues.



Monitor stock discrepancies and investigate the reasons behind incorrect availability.



Support the process of mapping supplier SKUs to internal SKUs and customer-facing product codes.



Help build better processes for automatic or semi-automatic stock and price updates.



Identify risky data situations such as incorrect cost prices, missing margins, outdated supplier feeds, duplicated products, or invalid EANs.



Orders, Sales & Operational Support



Support the ERP workflow related to customer orders, supplier orders, delivery notes, invoices, returns, and credit notes.



Check whether orders are correctly reflected in the ERP system.



Coordinate with internal departments when ERP data does not match the real business situation.



Help identify operational bottlenecks related to data quality, order processing, warehouse coordination, or supplier communication.



Support reporting related to sales, purchasing, stock, profitability, and operational performance.



Process Improvement & Automation



Analyze existing ERP workflows and suggest improvements.



Help reduce manual work by identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated.



Work with Excel, Google Sheets, CSV imports/exports, ERP import tools, and possibly API/EDI-related workflows.



Participate in improving internal processes for product onboarding, price updates, order processing, invoicing, and reporting.



Support the creation of standardized templates for supplier files, product uploads, and internal reporting.



Work closely with management to make the ERP system more reliable, scalable, and useful for business decisions.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a person who is not only technically capable, but also business-minded.



The ideal candidate understands that ERP data is not just “information in a system” — it directly affects sales, purchasing, stock accuracy, customer satisfaction, profitability, and operational efficiency.



You should be able to notice when something does not make sense, ask the right questions, and propose solutions.



Required Skills and Experience



Strong previous experience working with ERP systems, inventory systems, product information systems, or similar business software.



Excellent understanding of business data such as products, suppliers, customers, orders, stock, prices, invoices, purchase orders, and sales documents.



Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filters, lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning, CSV handling, and large file management.



Strong attention to detail and ability to detect inconsistencies in data.



Experience working with product catalogues, supplier price lists, stock files, or e-commerce data is highly preferred.



Ability to understand workflows across purchasing, sales, logistics, warehouse, invoicing, and reporting.



Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.



Good written English communication skills.



Ability to document processes clearly and follow structured procedures.



Highly Valued Skills



Experience in wholesale, distribution, retail, e-commerce, marketplace operations, or B2B trading.



Experience with EDI, APIs, product feeds, XML, CSV, JSON, or automated data imports.



Understanding of EAN, SKU, ASIN, MPN, brand mapping, category mapping, and product matching.



Experience with ERP systems such as SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, NetSuite, Zoho, ERPNext, or similar platforms.



Experience with PIM systems, supplier portals, retailer portals, or marketplace back-office tools.



Basic understanding of SQL, databases, or reporting tools would be a strong advantage.



Experience with automation tools, data validation, or workflow optimization.



Understanding of margin calculations, cost prices, sales prices, VAT, discounts, and profitability.



Personal Qualities



Structured and organized.



Very detail-oriented.



Analytical and curious.



Responsible and reliable.



Able to think independently.



Not afraid to ask questions when something is unclear.



Able to understand the bigger picture, not only the immediate task.



Comfortable working with large amounts of data.



Patient and precise when working with complex systems.



Interested in improving processes, not only completing tasks.



Able to communicate clearly with management and other departments.



What This Role Is Not



This is not a simple administrative assistant role.



This is not only copy-paste work.



This is not only mechanical data entry.



This is not a role for someone who only waits for exact instructions.



We need someone who can understand the logic behind the ERP system and actively help us make it better.



Example Tasks



Review a supplier file with 20,000 products and identify missing EANs, duplicated SKUs, wrong categories, invalid prices, and products with no stock.



Prepare a clean product import file for the ERP system.



Compare supplier stock data with ERP stock data and investigate discrepancies.



Create a structured report showing products with low margin, missing purchase price, or outdated supplier price.



Check why certain customer orders were not processed correctly in the ERP system.



Help define a better process for uploading supplier price lists.



Document the correct steps for creating a new product in the ERP system.



Support integration between ERP data and customer or supplier platforms.



Identify recurring manual tasks that should be automated.



Working Arrangement



This position can be remote, hybrid, or office-based depending on the candidate’s location and experience.



We are open to international candidates, including candidates based in the Philippines, Eastern Europe, or other regions, provided they have strong English communication skills and relevant ERP/data experience.



For exceptional candidates, long-term cooperation and relocation opportunities may be considered.



What We Offer



A serious long-term role in a growing international business.



Exposure to real B2B wholesale, retail, e-commerce, logistics, and ERP operations.



Opportunity to work with large catalogues, suppliers, customer platforms, and business-critical data.



A role with responsibility, not just routine tasks.



Opportunity to improve systems, workflows, and internal processes.



Direct communication with management.

title: DevOps/Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are on the hunt for a DevOps/Senior Full Stack Developer who embodies technical prowess and thrives in an environment where hard work, direct communication, and good humour are a staple of our day. If you’re ready to contribute to a team that pushes the envelope while rowing towards a common mission, you might just be the ideal candidate.



In this role, your responsibilities will span several critical technology domains:

1. API and Automation Development: You will be responsible for maintaining and building our internal APIs and automations, ensuring optimal functionality and adaptability to meet our needs. You will also work on our internal tools.

Customer Integration Support: You will assist our customer-facing team with integrating our solutions into client CRMs and other APIs, facilitating efficient and seamless interactions.

2. You will be responsible for improving landing page performance through ongoing visual updates and structured A/B testing. This includes testing headlines, layouts, and user flows to increase conversion rates, analysing results, and implementing winning variations. You’ll work closely with marketing to ensure all pages are optimised for performance, user experience, and lead quality.

3. Software Maintenance: Working alongside our COO, you will help maintain and enhance our internal proprietary lead distribution software, which is pivotal for managing lead capture, validation and distribution to client APIs. This software acts as the business OS.

4. Innovation and Creative Development: Innovation is at our core. You’ll have the chance to work with cutting-edge technologies, including AI, and engage in ambitious projects where you can unleash your creative potential and have a significant hand in their development from start to finish.



About You:

Experience: You should have at least 5 years of robust experience in full-stack development, with strong expertise in Node.js, Express, and SQL databases. Proficiency in JavaScript and API’s is essential, Experience with Zapier, N8N and CRM’s (Mautic, Pipedrive etc..), Next JS, Express JS - For Backend, Vanilla JS, CSS, Figma, Framer, GIT version control commands. Python and React(MUI) knowledge is also good to have but not required.

Industry Knowledge: A background in marketing technologies and CRM systems is highly favoured, enabling you to effectively support our bespoke needs and customer integrations.

Work Ethic: You are known for your drive, diligence, and commitment to excellence, thriving in an environment free of BS and big egos, ready to face challenges head-on.

Culture Fit: You appreciate a team-oriented atmosphere where everyone contributes and maintains a spirited demeanour, even under pressure. You are dedicated to our collective mission and ready to make a positive impact on our team dynamics.



How to Apply:

If you’re excited about making a substantial impact and pushing the boundaries of technology with a team that blends hard work with fun, we want to hear from you. Send us your CV and a cover letter explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role. During the application process, we will require you to verify your identity to maintain the authenticity of our hiring process.

title: Webflow SEO Specialist
description:
MMG Studio builds conversion-focused websites and marketing systems for mid-market B2B and healthcare companies. We don't sell pretty. We build sites that support sales, reduce risk, and hold up under executive scrutiny.



We're looking for a Technical SEO Specialist who can own the search performance pipeline across our client projects. This isn't a "write some meta descriptions" role. You'll be responsible for auditing, fixing, and reporting on the technical health of Webflow-built websites and translating that data into decisions that actually move rankings.



You'll work directly with leadership. No layers. No committees. That means your analysis needs to be sharp, your reporting needs to be clear, and your instincts need to be grounded in how search engines interact with real websites.



What You'll Do



Conduct full technical SEO audits across Webflow-built client sites, identifying and resolving issues directly within the platform

Build and maintain performance reports using Google Search Console, Looker Studio, and SE Ranking, structured for client-facing clarity and internal decision-making

Monitor and improve site speed across all client properties. Slow sites cost rankings and credibility. Neither is acceptable.

Set up and manage tracking in Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager. Data that isn't properly collected can't be acted on.

Run ongoing keyword research and gap analysis using SEMrush and SE Ranking

Integrate AI tools into your workflow. We actively use Claude Code and AI-assisted development, and we expect you to be comfortable working alongside those tools, not threatened by them.

Flag issues early and communicate clearly. Our clients operate in high-scrutiny environments where a broken canonical or missing schema tag has real business consequences.

What We're Looking For



3+ years of hands-on technical SEO experience. This is non-negotiable. We need someone who thinks in crawl logic, not someone who's "interested in learning SEO."



Tool stack requirements:



SE Ranking: deep working knowledge of audit workflows, rank tracking, and reporting

Google Search Console: building and interpreting performance reports

Google Analytics: setup, tracking validation, and data analysis

SEMrush: keyword research, gap analysis, and competitive auditing

Looker Studio: building clean, client-facing dashboards and reports

Webflow: enough working knowledge to implement technical fixes directly without waiting on a developer

Claude Code and AI-assisted workflows: comfort using AI tools as part of your daily process

Beyond the tools:



A data-first mindset. You should be able to look at a drop in impressions and work backwards to a cause, not just report that a drop happened.

Strong communication skills. You'll interface with clients and internal leadership directly. If you can't explain a technical finding in plain language, this isn't the right fit.

Ability to meet deadlines without reminders. We operate in fast-moving client environments where timelines are real and slipping isn't an option.

title: Executive Assistant to Business Owner — Long-Term, AI-Forward Role
description:
Executive Assistant to Business Owner — Long-Term, AI-Forward Role



Hours: 

Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm AWST (same time zone as Philippines — no nightshift). 8 working hours + 1-hour unpaid lunch, plus two 15-min paid breaks.



Salary: 

$1,200–$1,500 USD/month, depending on experience



Includes: 13th-month pay, 10+ days paid leave, PH public holidays observed, HMO allowance



Start date: 

Approx. 3–4 weeks from posting (allowing time for our full hiring process)



About us

We run two Pilates studios in Perth, Western Australia, and we're growing. I'm the owner, and I'm hiring a long-term executive assistant to help me run the business day-to-day.



What success looks like six months from now

• My inbox is under your ownership. Nothing falls through the cracks, and I only see the
s that genuinely need me.

• The two studio inboxes are filtered and organised for our studio managers. You run the daily rhythm work (suspensions, cancellations, daily reporting, follow-ups), and make sure nothing gets missed so the managers can prioritise the in-person experience with our members.

• Our monthly rhythms (end-of-month reporting, social platform and website updates) happen autonomously. You own the calendar.

• When I bring you something new such as a marketing campaign, an event, a research task, a new playbook to build, you run with it. You ask sharp questions upfront, then I get out of your way. 



The shape of the role

Roughly 80% recurring ownership, 20?-hoc projects assigned by me.



You'll own three big areas:

1. Inbox & communication — my personal business inbox and both studio inboxes. This is the foundation of the role.

2. Recurring business rhythms — the monthly and weekly tasks that keep the business healthy (reporting, newsletters, online presence, etc.)

3. Project support — onboarding new staff, building playbooks, marketing campaigns, supplier coordination, event prep, product research. 



Who I'm looking for

Attitude over experience. Specifically:

• Autonomous. I'll give you the goal and the context, not step-by-step instructions. You ask good questions when stuck, and bring solutions to the table — or we problem-solve it together.

• Detail-obsessed. You spot the typo, the wrong date, a task that's been missed. Things don't slip past you.

• Takes initiative. You see something that needs doing and you do it — or flag it. You don't wait to be told.

• Warm but professional. You understand that every message represents the brand. You communicate with care, you read situations well, and people walk away from your replies feeling valued.

• Process-driven AND ambitious. You take pride in systems that run like clockwork — inboxes at zero, trackers up to date, nothing slipping through. But you also want to grow into bigger responsibilities over time.

• AI-curious. You already use Claude, or similar, in your workflow, or you're hungry to learn. We use AI heavily and you'll be expected to as well.

• Eager to grow into sales & marketing. Strong systems are the foundation, but you're genuinely curious about how businesses attract members, run campaigns, and convert leads. You may not be writing high-converting promo
s or diagnosing campaign performance yet — but you want to learn, and you'll bring ideas to the table along the way.



How to apply

This is a thorough process because I'm hiring for the long term. Here's what to expect:



Step 1 — Application. Put the words STRONG EXECUTIVE in your subject line. Your application must include two things:



A. A short written intro. In the body of your
, write 2–3 sentences telling me why you'd be a great fit for this role.



B. A video (max 3 minutes) answering:

1. Why are you interested in this position?

2. What kinds of tasks give you energy?

3. What initiative have you taken in a previous role that had the biggest impact?

4. What skills do you want to develop in this role?



Step 2 — Shortlist & assessment. Top candidates complete a short personality/values assessment.



Step 3 — Initial interview. A 30–45 minute video call so we can get to know each other, and you can ask me questions about the role and the business.



Step 4 — Paid test project. Final 3 candidates are paid $50 USD to complete a real-world test project (3–4 hours). Same brief for everyone. I won't give you step-by-step instructions — I want to see how you think.



Step 5 — Final interview & offer.



If you've read this far and you're nodding along, I'd love to hear from you.

- Prepare and distribute financial reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) on a recurring schedule to management

- Coordinate proactively with management to understand the nature of transactions — do not guess or make assumptions

- Present financial findings clearly to the CFO, including trends, concerns, and notable variances

- Manage full-cycle accounts receivable — invoice creation, tracking, follow-up, and posting payments accurately

- Manage full-cycle accounts payable — entering bills, verifying amounts, scheduling payments, and maintaining vendor records

- Maintain tidy, audit-ready books at all times





ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES (NICE TO HAVE)



- Track and reconcile construction draw requests and lender disbursements

- Assist with tracking investor capital contributions and distributions across fund entities

- Maintain a master chart of accounts and ensure consistent categorization standards across all entities

- Create or maintain recurring financial reporting templates and dashboards

- Support onboarding and training of a future bookkeeping tea
mber if necessary

- Maintain vendor and contractor records and 1099 tracking for year-end

- Assist with cash flow forecasting and weekly cash position reporting

- Flag and research any discrepancies between internal records and external statements

- Maintain a transaction log or notes file for anything that required a judgment call or management input





QUICKBOOKS ONLINE — NON-NEGOTIABLE



QuickBooks Online proficiency is required. You must have extensive hands-on experience with QBO including journal entries, bank feeds, reconciliations, class and location tracking, and financial reporting. There is very little training available for the core bookkeeping functions. If you have done this work before, you will know how to do it here.





REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent English required — written and spoken. You will communicate directly with U.S.-based management and present financial findings in English. Non-negotiable.

- Prior experience with real estate bookkeeping is required, including journal entries related to property closings

- Experience working with multiple entities, inter-company transactions, and holding company structures preferred

- Stable, fast, reliable internet connection is required. You must provide a speed test screenshot and proof of your internet connection during the interview. Connection drops, lag, and instability are not acceptable in this role.

- Quiet, professional work environment is required. Video calls are a regular part of this role. Background noise, household disruptions, or unprofessional audio are disqualifying. This includes — and we mean this literally — no chickens, roosters, dogs, or household noise in the background during calls.

- Must be available for video calls throughout the week during U.S. business hours (at least partial overlap with Central or Eastern Time)

- Must be reliable, responsive, and able to meet recurring deadlines consistently

- On the application copy and paste the word in parentheses without the parentheses as the only answer to question 3 (copper), nothing more and nothing less but still complete the entire application

- Experience with construction or development project accounting is a plus

- Experience supporting investors or fund management entities is a plus





OUR HIRING PROCESS IS THOROUGH BY DESIGN



There are three rounds of interviews for this position. We will ask you to walk us through your bookkeeping process, explain how you handle specific scenarios, and demonstrate your knowledge in QuickBooks Online. If you truly have the experience you claim, this will be easy. If you do not, we will know. We are looking for someone who is as good as their resume says they are — and we verify.



Round 1 — Written screening and background review

Round 2 — Video call with management, process walkthrough and Q&A

Round 3 — Final interview with CFO, financial presentation exercise





GROWTH & FUTURE OPPORTUNITY



This role begins at 20 hours per week with the expectation of growing from there. We are building our accounting function and want someone who can grow with us. Two paths exist:



- You perform exceptionally well and transition to a full-time role as our in-house controller

- You remain part-time and help us recruit, onboard, and train an additional bookkeeper to support growing volume



Either path is a real opportunity for the right person. We invest in people who invest in us.





WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



- Someone who needs extensive training on basic bookkeeping — we do not have time for that

- Someone who guesses at categorizations and figures it will get fixed later

- Someone who disappears, misses deadlines, or is hard to reach

- Someone who is not comfortable on video calls or communicating in English

- Someone with unreliable internet or a chaotic home environment





HOW TO APPLY



Apply using the link below. In your application, please include:



- Your resume and a brief description of your bookkeeping experience

- A screenshot or proof of your internet connection speed test

- A description of your work environment and how you ensure quiet during calls

- Your experience with real estate closings and QuickBooks Online specifically



Please answer all questions in the application form completely and carefully. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



APPLY HERE:

About us

Our founder, Wanner, posts daily across Instagram, TikTok, and X under three brands: 
 CashCowConsulting funnel runs on ManyChat keyword automations across all three accounts.



What you'll actually do



This role is half coordinator, half builder. You keep content flowing daily AND own our ManyChat conversion system.



Daily execution (the coordinator half)



- Post 5 trial Reels per day 
 Instagram — Clipper delivers these to you, you schedule and post them consistently

 accounts, 1 TikTok accounts, and 2 X accounts — we'll give you a clear matrix of what content goes where

- Communicate with editors (Clipper, Noud, the rest of the team) in Slack — chase down missing assets, flag delays, keep the pipeline moving

- EOD update to Noud every workday — what was posted, what's pending, what's blocked



-> Saterday 2 hours of work required , we are a very motivated team and we don't sleep neither does social media.



ManyChat ownership (the builder half)



- Build and optimize ManyChat keyword 
 that convert IG/TikTok comments into qualified leads

- A/B test hooks, replies, and CTAs — you'll have full ownership here, with Noud and Hugo (COO) available for training and review

- Map every flow — we want documented, auditable funnels, not a tangled mess only you understand

- Spot drop-off points and propose fixes proactively (we shouldn't have to ask)



Weekly research + reporting



- Friday report to Noud and Wanner: top 5 performing posts across all platforms, what worked, what didn't

- 10–15 spin-off content ideas per week based on what's performing — you spot the patterns, the editing team makes them

- Competitor research: what hooks are landing in the YouTube automation / online business niche? Flag 2–3 ideas per week worth copying or adapting



What success looks like in 90 days



- Zero missed posting days across all accounts 

- All ManyChat flows documented in a single place, with at least 2 A/B tests already run

- Noud spends zero time on Reels editing, scheduling, or ManyChat — you've fully taken it

- You've asked dozens of questions, proposed at least 5 process improvements, and aren't waiting to be told what to do



Who you are



Must have:



- 3+ year managing social media for a real business (not personal accounts)

- Hands-on ManyChat experience — keyword triggers, conditional logic, A/B testing. If you've only "used" ManyChat once, this isn't your role.

- Proactive personality — you ask questions constantly, including to ChatGPT/Claude. You don't wait for instructions; you propose solutions. We will screen heavily for this.

- Excellent written English — you live in Slack

- Strong organizational instincts — content calendars, scheduling tools, documentation

- Comfortable with Metricool, Later, Buffer, or similar

- 4+ hours of daily overlap with European working hours (CET)

- Fast internet, quiet workspace for calls



Strongly preferred (near-required at the top of our budget):



- Direct experience in the YouTube automation / faceless YouTube / online business education niche — if you've worked for a creator or coach in this space, lead with that

- Understanding of how short-form content feeds top-of-funnel into a coaching/info-product business

- Familiarity with Instagram's algorithm, current Reels best practices, and TikTok crossposting strategy



Bonus:



- You've worked with European or US founders before

- You consume YouTube automation content yourself



What we offer

, TikTok, and YouTube. We have a strong team already in place: editors, scripters, a posting lead, and funnels that convert. mbers who do quality and a large quantity of work. And the payoff? Potential bonuses up to 50% of the original monthly salary!

title: Lifecycle Marketing & Klaviyo Strategist (High-Ticket E-Commerce)
description:
Lifecycle Marketing & Klaviyo Strategist (High-Ticket E-Commerce)

Remote Contract Position



Part-Time to Start | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We’re looking for someone who understands that high-ticket customers do not buy the same way as impulse shoppers.



This is not a “send a few newsletters” role.



This is a deep lifecycle marketing position focused on customer psychology, segmentation, automation strategy, retention, lead nurturing, and revenue growth inside Klaviyo for a fast-growing high-ticket poultry and outdoor lifestyle e-commerce brand.



Our customers often spend weeks researching before purchasing. They compare shipping options, financing, layouts, upgrades, predator protection, flock types, and long-term durability before making a decision.



We need someone who can build systems that guide customers through that journey naturally.



You’ll help architect the full customer lifecycle:



lead capture

nurture sequences

quote follow-up systems

financing psychology flows

segmentation

SMS strategy

post-purchase retention

referral systems

customer education funnels

reactivation campaigns

customer lifetime value growth



This is a strategic role, not a basic
 assistant position.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Lifecycle Strategy & Automation

Build and optimize advanced Klaviyo flows

Create customer journeys based on behavior, products viewed, financing interest, quiz answers, and engagement

Develop nurture sequences for long consideration-cycle customers

Create quote follow-up systems and reactivation campaigns

Build segmented flows for different customer types and buying behaviors

Improve retention and repeat engagement

Customer Psychology & Conversion Optimization

Understand emotional friction points that prevent purchases

Develop flows around:

financing hesitation

shipping anxiety

custom order overwhelm

first-time flock owner education

delivery expectations

seasonal buying behavior

Write messaging that feels human, helpful, and trustworthy — not robotic or spammy

Segmentation & Personalization

Build advanced customer segments

Implement lead scoring logic

Personalize flows based on:

browsing behavior

quote activity

purchase history

coop type interest

flock type

financing engagement

geographic considerations

customer engagement level

Analytics & Optimization

Monitor flow performance and attributed revenue

Run A/B tests

Improve open rates, click rates, and conversion rates

Identify drop-off points in the customer journey

Recommend new revenue opportunities

Report on performance trends and actionable insights

Collaboration

Work directly with ownership

Translate real customer conversations and objections into scalable automation systems

Help shape long-term retention and lifecycle strategy

Required Experience

You MUST Have:

Strong Klaviyo experience

Shopify experience

Advanced segmentation experience

Automation and flow-building experience

 and SMS lifecycle marketing experience

Strong understanding of conversion psychology

Experience with high-ticket e-commerce

Strong written English

Ability to think strategically, not just execute tasks

Strong organizational and analytical skills

Huge Bonus Points If You Have Experience With:

HubSpot

Quiz funnels

Long sales-cycle businesses

Outdoor structures, sheds, cabins, or home improvement industries

Freight or logistics-related businesses

AI-assisted personalization

Retention marketing strategy

Customer lifetime value optimization

UGC/review/referral systems

This Role Is NOT For Someone Who…



We want to be upfront about the level of thinking this role requires.



This is not a basic “send campaigns and build abandoned carts” position.



We are looking for someone who understands:



customer psychology

long buying cycles

lifecycle marketing

segmentation

conversion behavior

and revenue strategy



This role is NOT for someone who:



relies mostly on prebuilt Klaviyo templates

sends generic mass campaigns with little segmentation

focuses more on aesthetics than conversion strategy

only has experience with low-ticket impulse purchases

writes robotic or overly corporate copy

uses heavy discounts as the primary strategy

builds flows once and never optimizes them

needs constant direction for every task

cannot analyze customer behavior or buying friction

has never worked with long consideration-cycle customers

thinks
 marketing ends after checkout

is looking for a passive “set it and forget it” client



We are looking for someone who enjoys:



solving conversion problems

analyzing customer behavior

building smart automation systems

testing and optimizing

improving customer trust and confidence

and finding hidden revenue opportunities



If your experience is mostly:

“welcome flow + abandoned cart + monthly newsletters,”

this role is probably not the right fit.



What Success Looks Like

Increased quote-to-sale conversion

Improved customer engagement

Better lead warming

Higher flow-attributed revenue

Increased financing conversions

Better reactivation performance

Improved retention and repeat engagement

Better customer segmentation and personalization

Lower unsubscribe rates

Stronger customer trust and confidence

Hours & Compensation

Part-time to start (approximately 10–20 hours/week)

Long-term growth opportunity

Flexible remote work

Compensation based on experience and ability level

Performance bonuses may be available for strong results

Additional Application & Screening Process



Because this is a strategic lifecycle marketing role, we use a more in-depth screening process than a typical marketing position.



We are not simply looking for someone who can “send
s.” We are looking for someone who understands customer psychology, segmentation, buying behavior, and revenue strategy.



Initial Application Questions



Please answer the following thoughtfully. We care far more about your thinking process than polished buzzwords.



1. Customer Psychology



Why do you think a customer would request a shipping quote for a premium chicken coop and then stop responding afterward?



2. Strategic Prioritization



If you inherited a Klaviyo account generating little revenue, what are the first 3 things you would audit and why?



3. Lifecycle Strategy



A customer:



viewed premium coops multiple times

visited financing twice

requested a shipping quote

then disappeared after receiving shipping pricing



Walk us through the lifecycle flow you would build for this customer.



4. Segmentation



Give 3 examples of customer segments you would build for a high-ticket coop company and explain why.



Finalist Evaluation Process



Finalists may be asked to complete a paid mini audit of our current lifecycle marketing systems.



This may include:



reviewing flows

identifying customer journey gaps

segmentation opportunities

reactivation opportunities

quote recovery strategy

lifecycle optimization ideas



We are specifically looking for strategic thinkers who can identify revenue opportunities, customer friction points, and automation improvements — not just suggest generic campaigns or templates.



What We Look For In Strong Candidates



Strong candidates naturally think and speak in terms of:



customer behavior

segmentation

friction points

customer confidence

trust-building

buying stages

lifecycle journeys

retention

reactivation

attribution

customer lifetime value



We value strategic thinking far more than flashy design work or generic marketing buzzwords.



To Apply



Please send:



your resume or portfolio

examples of Klaviyo flows or lifecycle systems you’ve built

answers to the questions above

relevant platform experience

and anything else you feel demonstrates strong strategic marketing ability



We are looking for someone who understands customer behavior and lifecycle strategy — not just someone who knows how to send
s.
